g.text: Solid box: something that runs. Dashed box: a boundary (a host, a container, a cloud). Arrows: who calls whom. Dashed arrow: build time.
CodeMirror editor · course map · tutor panel · duel room
api.ts → REST with the Supabase JWT
TypeScript types for every REST response and socket event,
imported by web and api, so both sides change together
Caddy 2 · :443 HTTPS (Let's Encrypt) · reverse_proxy → api:3001, WebSockets included
Every request: JwtAuthGuard → throttle → ValidationPipe → controller → service → HttpExceptionFilter
Each module: a thin controller → a service with the rules and the Drizzle queries (ADR-015). Every service uses DbService.
Kept in memory, so exactly one API instance:
issues the JWTs the API verifies
explain an error · a hint · a card, differently
English and Hinglish, written by hand

API end-to-end on PGlite · Playwright journeys
The server decides: grades, XP, streaks,
Elo and duel winners. Hidden tests, duel
solutions and API keys never leave it.
